integration_scope: frogcs research branch only; no writes to RC6 submission or other repositories
scientific_question: Does inherited aquatic stage composition constrain later adult calling-site selection, juvenile survival, and multi-site community configuration across hydroperiod transitions?

frozen_rc6.claim_ceiling: adult acoustic space use only; no larval density, predation, breeding success or causal rainfall inference

source_modules.can_join: only by aggregate result or independently verified physical waterbody

source_modules.granularity: park × verified recorder station × taxon × year
source_modules.can_join: within NPS recorder geography; hydroperiod is broad category

source_modules.scientific_ceiling: phenology and lagged larval-stage calibration if co-located taxon/time coverage passes

source_modules.can_join: never infer local predation from global/source edge

source_modules.role: time-varying physical pond-water level and dry/reset events
source_modules.can_join: only with verified pond/date, not ERA5 or JRC alone

source_modules.role: measured egg/larval survival and predator-stage abundance
source_modules.can_join: requires direct counts and effort/detection or experiment

endpoints.label: same-year adult acoustic site-use
endpoints.required: adult call/effort and strictly prior species histories

endpoints.label: same-season egg/larval survival and stage-specific predation
endpoints.required: same wetland egg/larva/predator census and hydrology plus attack/exclusion information for causal predation
endpoints.claim: ontogenetic interactions conditional on directly measured exposure

endpoints.label: future adult recruitment after maturity lag
endpoints.required: longitudinal cohort survival/age at maturity and subsequent calling

endpoints.label: conditional spatial configuration
endpoints.required: new held-out monitoring panel with first-order state and total-activity conditioned null
endpoints.claim: extra spatial dependence conditional on baseline

gates.name: source-blind physical-site, species, time and stage coverage audit
held-out previous-call -> directly observed overwintered-larva calibration
cohort maturation plus spatial configuration prediction

stop_rules: No modification of frozen RC6 paper, submission, provenance, spatial generator or NAAMP analysis paths.
Do not use global GloBI, GBIF, EarthEnv, NWI, ERA5 or JRC rows as a same-pond stage-specific predation measurement.
No source-blind response reuse: NAAMP post-hoc interspecific H1 exploration is not prospective confirmation.
No published mechanism language when measured hydroperiod, stage/predation exposure and event-level detection are absent.
A same-year egg predation event cannot causally explain an earlier adult chorus from that cohort.
